scenarios.name: attack-creates-one-knight-per-opponent
scenarios.why: Power and toughness are each equal to the number of creatures you control (alone: 1/1); whenever it attacks, create a number of 2/2 white Knight tokens with vigilance equal to the number of opponents you have (one).

scenarios.name: vigilance-attacker-untapped-and-pt-grows
scenarios.why: Vigilance means the attacking Squadron never tapped; with the Bears and the Sable, and then the created tapped-and-attacking Knight token, four creatures you control give its CDA 4/4. The CR-correct combat damage is Squadron 4 + Knight 2 = 6 (p1 at 14); the Knight never joining the attackers is the recorded divergence.
